definition.def: Voluntary actions or activities are done because someone chooses to do them and not because they have been forced to do them.
examples: Attention is drawn to a special voluntary course in Commercial French.
The scheme, due to begin next month, will be voluntary.

definition.def: Voluntary work is done by people who are not paid for it, but who do it because they want to do it.
examples: In her spare time she does voluntary work.
He'd been working at the local hostel on a voluntary basis.

definition.def: A voluntary worker is someone who does work without being paid for it, because they want to do it.
examples: They have achieved more with voluntary workers in three years than most organisations with paid workers have achieved in ten.
We depend solely upon our voluntary helpers.

definition.def: A voluntary organization is controlled and organized by the people who have chosen to work for it, often without being paid, rather than receiving help or money from the government.
examples: Some local authorities and voluntary organizations also run workshops for people with disabilities.
It has been largely through the voluntary sector that the needs of victims have been met.

examples.sentence: It is freely chosen, spontaneous and voluntary.
